mapper.sql: a.car03_booking_id AS booking_id, a.car03_info_id AS info_id, a.car03_person_id AS person_id, a.car03_start_date AS start_date, a.car03_start_hour AS start_hour, a.car03_start_min AS start_min, COALESCE(a.car03_close_date, a.car03_start_date) AS close_date, a.car03_close_hour AS close_hour, a.car03_close_min AS close_min, a.car03_destination AS destination, a.car03_reason AS reason, a.car03_attendance AS attendance, a.car03_note AS note, a.car03_parent_id AS parent_id, a.car03_reg_emp_id AS reg_emp_id, f_emp_kor_nm(a.car03_person_id) AS person_nm, b.car01_car_nm AS info_nm
mapper.select: SELECT , a.car03_start_hour||':'||a.car03_start_min||' ~ '||a.car03_close_hour||':'||a.car03_close_min AS time FROM car03_booking a INNER JOIN car01_info b ON a.car03_info_id = b.car01_info_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.car01_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.car03_parent_id = 0 AND to_char(f_sysdate(),'YYYYMMDD') <= to_char(COALESCE(a.car03_close_date, a.car03_start_date),'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY a.car03_start_date, COALESCE(a.car03_close_date, a.car03_start_date) DESC, b.car01_car_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT COALESCE(car03_booking_id, 1) AS booking_id , COALESCE(car03_person_id, 0) AS person_id , COALESCE(car03_info_id, 0) AS info_id , COALESCE(car03_start_date, CAST(#{date} AS date)) AS start_date , COALESCE(f_emp_kor_nm(car03_person_id), ' ') AS person_nm , COALESCE(car03_destination, ' ') AS destination , COALESCE(car01_car_nm, ' ') AS info_nm , to_char(COALESCE(car03_start_time, to_timestamp(to_char(f_trunc(CAST(#{date} AS timestamp)),'YYYYMMDD')||'080000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS start_time , to_char(COALESCE(car03_close_time, to_timestamp(to_char(f_trunc(CAST(#{date} AS timestamp)),'YYYYMMDD')||'080000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS close_time FROM car01_info t0 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT a.* , to_timestamp(to_char(f_trunc(car03_start_date),'YYYYMMDD')||car03_start_hour||car03_start_min||'01', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS car03_start_time , to_timestamp(to_char(f_trunc(car03_start_date),'YYYYMMDD')||car03_close_hour||car03_close_min||'00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS car03_close_time FROM car03_booking a WHERE car03_start_date = #{date} ) t1 ON t0.car01_info_id = t1.car03_info_id WHERE 1=1 AND car01_company_id = #{companyId} AND car01_car_type LIKE '2' UNION ALL SELECT 1 , 0 , 0 , CAST(#{date} AS date) , ' ' , ' ' , '공용차량 사용시간' , to_char(to_timestamp(to_char(f_trunc(CAST(#{date} AS timestamp)),'YYYYMMDD')||'080000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , to_char(to_timestamp(to_char(f_trunc(CAST(#{date} AS timestamp)),'YYYYMMDD')||'190000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY 4
SELECT , CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS time FROM car03_booking a INNER JOIN car01_info b ON a.car03_info_id = b.car01_info_id WHERE a.car03_booking_id = #{bookingId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car03_booking WHERE car03_booking_id = #{bookingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO car03_booking (car03_booking_id, car03_info_id, car03_person_id, car03_start_date, car03_start_hour, car03_start_min, car03_close_date, car03_close_hour, car03_close_min, car03_destination, car03_reason, car03_attendance, car03_note, car03_parent_id, car03_reg_emp_id) VALUES (#{bookingId}, #{req.infoId}, #{req.personId}, #{startDate}, #{req.startHour}, #{req.startMin}, #{closeDate}, #{req.closeHour}, #{req.closeMin}, #{req.destination}, #{req.reason}, #{req.attendance}, #{req.note}, #{parentId}, #{req.regEmpId})
mapper.update: UPDATE car03_booking SET car03_info_id = #{req.infoId}, car03_person_id = #{req.personId}, car03_start_date = #{startDate}, car03_start_hour = #{req.startHour}, car03_start_min = #{req.startMin}, car03_close_date = #{closeDate}, car03_close_hour = #{req.closeHour}, car03_close_min = #{req.closeMin}, car03_destination = #{req.destination}, car03_reason = #{req.reason}, car03_attendance = #{req.attendance}, car03_note = #{req.note}, car03_parent_id = #{parentId}, car03_reg_emp_id = #{req.regEmpId} WHERE car03_booking_id = #{bookingId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM car03_booking WHERE car03_booking_id IN #{id} AND car03_info_id IN (SELECT car01_info_id FROM car01_info WHERE car01_company_id = #{companyId})
